newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar struggles higher but gains capped.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar struggles higher but gains capped.

text.p: White sugar futures struggled to push higher in solid Wednesday trading but mixed sellers were waiting at and under $300 basis March and kept values pinioned in tight ranges.
Traders said steady trade buying on March coupled with mixed selling of the second-month May contract stretched the nearby spread, which was one of the main features of interest in the session.
"There haven't been any major trades at all...it's in a very tight range, very much like New York," said one.
"I don't think there's enough physical business going on to warrant the market moving much."
At 1713 GMT March was up just 20 cents at $298.00, near the upper end of its trading range. May was up by the same amount at $297.90, with other positions tightly mixed.
Volume amounted to a hefty 3,359 lots, boosted by against actuals trades and March/May crosses as the March expiry approaches.
Nearby Paris futures were slightly firmer but volume was sharply lower than in London at 763 lots.
March was up 60 cents at $298.30 and May up 30 cents at $298.10.
